department: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, GoI / TN Agriculture Dept
benefit_description: Direct income support of ₹6,000 per year delivered in 3 equal installments of ₹2,000 directly to bank accounts linked to Aadhaar.

land_criteria.description: All landholding farmer families having cultivable landholding in their names. Institutional landholders and high-income tax payers are excluded.

required_documents: Land ownership patta / Chitta / Land Record document
Active Mobile number linked to Aadhaar
application_steps: Step 1: Verify Aadhaar number and land records on PM-KISAN portal.
Step 2: Fill New Farmer Registration form with District, Sub-District, Village.
Step 3: Enter Survey/Khata/Khasra number and upload Land Record copy.
Step 4: Local Village Administrative Officer (VAO) / Assistant Agricultural Officer (AAO) approves physical verification.
verification_notes: Official portal verified active. National e-Governance standards compliant.

scheme_name: Tamil Nadu Micro Irrigation Scheme (PMKSY - Per Drop More Crop)
department: Department of Horticulture & Plantation Crops, Government of Tamil Nadu
benefit_description: High subsidy for installation of Drip and Sprinkler irrigation systems to conserve water and improve yield.
subsidy_details: 100% Subsidy for Small & Marginal Farmers (up to 5 acres); 75% Subsidy for Other Farmers.

land_criteria.description: Farmers having assured water source (well or borewell). Leaseholders with minimum 10-year registered lease deed are also eligible.

required_documents: Adangal / Crop cultivation certificate from VAO
Soil and Water Test Report from recognized laboratory
Electricity service connection receipt or well certificate
application_steps: Step 1: Register on TN Agriculture Agrisnet / eSevai portal.
Step 2: Submit land patta and water source proof to the Block Assistant Director of Horticulture.
Step 3: Joint field verification by Agricultural Engineering Dept and Horticulture officer.
Step 4: Work order issued for approved micro-irrigation firm.
verification_notes: Official portal verified on tnagrisnet.tn.gov.in. 100% subsidy active for small/marginal categories.

scheme_name: Kalaignar All Village Integrated Agriculture Development Programme (KAVIADP)
department: Agriculture & Farmers Welfare Department, Government of Tamil Nadu
benefit_description: Comprehensive village agricultural upliftment: free distribution of 2 coconut seedlings per household, vegetable seed minikits, dryland development, and farm machinery access.
subsidy_details: 100% Free inputs and subsidized machinery (up to ₹15,000 per eligible marginal farmer).

land_criteria.description: Priority to marginal and small farmers in notified village panchayats. Fallow land cultivators given priority.

required_documents: Land Chitta / Adangal or Village Panchayat resident proof
application_steps: Step 1: Contact Assistant Agricultural Officer (AAO) at Uzhavar Santhai or Block Agriculture Extension Centre (AEC).
Step 2: Submit family ration card and land record for seedling kit allocation.
Step 3: Collect sanctioned minikits and seeds at AEC.
verification_notes: TN Agrisnet flagship scheme. Active in selected village clusters per G.O. guidelines.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY) - Tamil Nadu Crop Insurance
department: Agriculture & Farmers Welfare Department, Government of Tamil Nadu & Central GoI
benefit_description: Comprehensive insurance cover against crop failure due to drought, unseasonal rainfall, floods, pests, and natural perils.
subsidy_details: Farmer pays minimal premium: 1.5% for Rabi, 2% for Kharif, 5% for Annual Horticultural Crops. Balance 95-98% subsidized by TN Govt & Central Govt.

land_criteria.description: All farmers growing notified crops in notified areas including sharecroppers and tenant farmers with tenancy agreement or VAO certificate.

required_documents: Adangal / Sowing certificate issued by Village Administrative Officer (VAO)
Land Ownership document (Patta / Chitta) or Tenancy agreement
Bank Passbook copy showing IFSC code
application_steps: Step 1: Obtain Adangal from local VAO or e-Sevai centre.
Step 2: Visit Primary Agricultural Cooperative Credit Society (PACCS), Commercial Bank, or Common Service Centre (CSC).
Step 3: Pay farmer premium share before district cut-off date (e.g. Nov 15/30 for Samba Paddy).
Step 4: Receive PMFBY acknowledgement receipt with policy number.
verification_notes: Official Central insurance portal PMFBY and TN Agrisnet tie-up. Seasonal deadlines apply strictly.

scheme_name: Agricultural Mechanization Programme (Sub-Mission on Agricultural Mechanization)
department: Agricultural Engineering Department (AED), Government of Tamil Nadu
benefit_description: Capital subsidy on procurement of tractors, power tillers, rotavators, paddy transplanters, laser land levelers, and power sprayers.
subsidy_details: 50% subsidy for Small, Marginal, SC/ST, and Women Farmers; 40% subsidy for other general category farmers.

land_criteria.description: Cultivating landowners. Priority quota for SC/ST, marginal (< 2.5 acres), and women farmers.

required_documents: Small / Marginal Farmer Certificate issued by Revenue Dept (for higher subsidy)
Quotation from empanelled agricultural machinery manufacturer
application_steps: Step 1: Register on Direct Benefit Transfer in Agricultural Mechanization (DBT-AgriMachinery) portal.
Step 2: Choose equipment model and empanelled dealer.
Step 3: Field verification and permit sanction by Executive Engineer (AED).
Step 4: Purchase equipment and subsidy credited directly to bank account after inspection.
verification_notes: National portal agrimachinery.nic.in with TN AED state administration.

scheme_name: Free Power Supply for Agricultural Pumpsets Scheme
department: Tamil Nadu Generation and Distribution Corporation (TANGEDCO)
benefit_description: 100% subsidized electricity for registered agricultural pump sets (open wells, tube wells, borewells) to minimize farm operating expenses.
subsidy_details: 100% electricity tariff subsidy funded by the Government of Tamil Nadu.

land_criteria.description: Farmers having agricultural land with an existing agricultural well/borewell seeking new connection or maintaining existing connection under agricultural tariff.

required_documents: Proof of ownership of land (Patta / Chitta)
VAO certificate of existence of open well or borewell
Consent letter from co-owners if joint patta
application_steps: Step 1: Submit Form 1 application to local TANGEDCO Section Office.
Step 2: Field inspection by Junior Engineer / Assistant Engineer.
Step 3: Registration in agricultural priority / normal seniority waitlist or Tatkal scheme.
Step 4: Sanction and service connection release.
verification_notes: Official TANGEDCO portal. Regular free supply quota sanctioned per state policy.

department: Department of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Government of Tamil Nadu
benefit_description: Distribution of certified paddy seeds, chemical fertilizers (DAP & Urea), and weed management inputs at 100% subsidy for delta paddy cultivators.
subsidy_details: 100% subsidy for certified paddy seed (up to 45 kg/ha) and fertilizer kit per acre.

land_criteria.description: Cauvery Delta farmers taking up Kuruvai paddy cultivation with borewell/canal water.

required_documents: Patta / Chitta or VAO Certificate of Kuruvai cultivation
application_steps: Step 1: Register Kuruvai cultivation plan at local Agriculture Extension Centre.
Step 2: Verification of canal/borewell readiness by AAO.
Step 3: Collection of subsidized seeds and fertilizers from Primary Agricultural Cooperative Societies.
verification_notes: Kuruvai seasonal window closed in July; Samba season schemes are now in effect.

scheme_name: Tamil Nadu Organic Farming Promotion Scheme
department: Department of Sustainable Agriculture, Government of Tamil Nadu
benefit_description: Financial assistance, certification support, and free biological inputs for farmers transitioning towards certified natural and organic farming.
subsidy_details: ₹10,000 per hectare incentive across 3 years + 100% covered certification fees.

land_criteria.description: Farmers willing to form Farmer Producer Groups or clusters (minimum 20-50 hectares cluster) or individual farm registration.

application_steps: Step 1: Apply through Tamil Nadu Organic Certification Department (TNOCD).
Step 2: Conversion inspection by organic certification inspectors.
Step 3: Sanction of cluster incentive.
verification_notes: Verified official TNOCD state department portal.
